primary_source.read_depth: Complete main text and all main legends; complete 18-page supplement text/captions/tables. Main figure images 4 and 5 and supplementary S3, S7, S12 inspected. Other images and raw data not independently analyzed.

administered_compounds.name: ABBV-744
administered_compounds.unique_result: Only compound administered to mice in this study. Substantial plaque reduction during concurrent high-fat feeding; not established-plaque reversal. No BUBR1 protein, muscle or chromosome-fidelity benefit measured.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain controlled vascular benefit; no MVA restoration or compensation established

administered_compounds.name: Molibresib
administered_compounds.unique_result: Retain cell lipid-uptake and inflammatory results with an unstimulated mouse-macrophage lipid-uptake null in S7c; no mouse treatment arm for this compound.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain cell-context positive and null; no MVA efficacy established

administered_compounds.name: (+)-JQ1
administered_compounds.unique_result: The BPS catalog identifies the positive enantiomer. Cell effects do not establish chronic safety or BUBR1 restoration; do not merge with (-)-JQ1. Punctuation-normalized catalog joins require stereoisomer review.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain positive-enantiomer cell comparator; no MVA efficacy established

administered_compounds.name: Apabetalone
administered_compounds.unique_result: Retain cellular inflammatory/lipid results and the separate adult BETonMACE primary cardiovascular endpoint that did not reach statistical significance. Neither is a BUBR1 or muscle-rescue test.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain cell effects and clinical uncertainty; no MVA efficacy established

administered_compounds.name: GSK046
administered_compounds.unique_result: Cell comparator with no animal treatment arm in this study. Separate identity from GSK620.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain cell comparator; no MVA restoration established

administered_compounds.name: GSK620
administered_compounds.unique_result: Cell comparator with no animal treatment arm in this study. Separate glioblastoma source identified for later reading; its result is not qualified here.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain cell comparator and further source question; no MVA restoration established

administered_compounds.name: MZ1
administered_compounds.unique_result: Administered degrader with cellular lipid/inflammatory effects; do not transfer inhibitor selectivity, dosing or animal outcomes to it.
administered_compounds.disposition: retain distinct degrader comparator; no MVA restoration established

cell_design.positive: Reduced inflammatory secretion and oxLDL uptake in selected conditions
limits: S3 dose curves have no statistical annotations and are not uniformly monotone
S7c unstimulated mouse-macrophage molibresib comparison is nonsignificant
Per-cell observations are not independent biological replicate counts; clustering treatment unclear
Short-term MTT is not a long-term survival, renewal or fidelity endpoint

bub1b_observation.intervention: Genetic shYAP, shTAZ or shBRD4 knockdown
bub1b_observation.readout: Lower BUB1B RNA in shared target analysis
bub1b_observation.interpretation: Neither restoration nor drug-induced BUBR1 loss is established by the genetic RNA finding.

mouse_ABBV744.model: Male C57BL/6J AAV-PCSK9, with separate AAV-PCSK9 plus YAP/TAZ-overexpression model
mouse_ABBV744.exposure: 5 mg/kg orally daily, concurrent with 60 days of high-fat diet
mouse_ABBV744.tissue_assay_n_per_group: 3–5 per Methods; exact panel-specific n not displayed
mouse_ABBV744.timing: Prevention during diet challenge, not treatment of established plaques
mouse_ABBV744.positive: Approximately twofold plaque reduction in standard model and over 50% in YAP/TAZ model, with selected histologic and inflammatory endpoints
null_or_limits: No skeletal-muscle function, survival or chromosome-fidelity endpoint
Systemic dosing does not identify an exclusive macrophage mediator
Main Methods do not describe randomization or blinding
S12 body weights are not comprehensive developmental or tumor-safety evidence

human_apabetalone.read_depth: Main trial design, primary efficacy, safety and Table 2; no protocol/supplement/raw-data review
human_apabetalone.context: Adults with type 2 diabetes and recent acute coronary syndrome; add-on to usual care
human_apabetalone.interpretation: Primary endpoint did not reach significance; not proof of zero benefit. Do not extrapolate results to every BET compound or to MVA.

identity_sources.purpose: Current GSK620 research listing, not the historical MCE batch

unread_followups.question: Separate GSK620 glioblastoma intervention, function and harms
unread_followups.depth: Search result only; not qualified evidence

decision: Retain model-specific positives. No demonstrated mechanism or functional advantage in the relevant MVA model; no nomination change or assertion of proven clinical inferiority.

followup_of.status: Bounded primary qualification now available; clinical transfer and specified source questions remain open
